letterbox.description: 1 fills the destination outside the rect with the letterbox color rather than the base.

rect.description: The destination rect as fractions of the destination extent: left, top, width, height.

sharpness.description: Reconstruction sharpness: 0 is bilinear, 1 clamped Catmull-Rom.

tonemap.description: 1 puts the reconstructed source through the filmic tonemap inside the rect; the base and the letterbox color are never tonemapped.

wipe.description: The held image's fraction of the rect in wipe mode.

workCounterRow.description: The place pass's row of the work counters.
